plainTranslation: Their Moon in your 7th house makes partnership feel emotionally significant. You may instinctively respond to them as someone to care for, choose, or negotiate with. This can be sweet, but it needs balanced giving so one person does not become the emotional manager.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
